title: Bounded Retry
prompt: Implement retry(fn, attempts) that calls fn() up to `attempts` times, returning the first successful result. If fn raises, sleep-free retry; when all attempts fail, re-raise the LAST exception.

tests.name: succeeds on a later attempt
tests.code:
calls = []
def flaky():
    calls.append(1)
    if len(calls) < 3:
        raise ValueError('nope')
    return 'ok'
assert retry(flaky, 5) == 'ok'
assert len(calls) == 3
tests.hint: Keep calling until success or attempts exhausted.

tests.name: last exception surfaces
tests.hint: The final error propagates — swallowed errors hide reality.

tests.name: zero attempts still tries once? No — attempts is a hard cap
